erv_lineage.rv_species.name: Ceratotherium-Rb
erv_lineage.description: Rhinoceros rhoretrovirus lineage identified from endogenous retroviral sequences.
erv_lineage.notes: One of the few known rhoretrovirus-related lineages in large mammals.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: CERV-1
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous chimpanzee gammaretrovirus lineage related to primate CERV and HERV groups.
erv_lineage.notes: One of the best-characterised endogenous retrovirus lineages in chimpanzees.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: CERV-2
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous chimpanzee gammaretrovirus lineage related to RD114-like retroviruses.
erv_lineage.notes: Related to the retrovirus lineage that includes feline RD114.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: CfERV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage present in domestic dogs and other canids.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: CfERV-Fc
erv_lineage.description: Canid member of the widespread ERV-Fc radiation that remained active until relatively recent evolutionary times.
erv_lineage.notes: Descends from a recombinant ERV-Fc lineage and includes insertions that remain polymorphic in modern dogs and wolves.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: ChrEFV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous foamy virus lineage identified in cape golden mole.
erv_lineage.notes: Revealed a previously unknown foamy virus lineage in afrotherian mammals.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: CoeEFV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous foamy virus lineage identified in coelacanth.
erv_lineage.notes: Extends the known host range of foamy viruses to lobe-finned fishes, suggesting possible codivergence with vertebrates over ~400 million years

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: Delta.3-MurAur
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous deltaretrovirus lineage identified in tube-nosed bats, preserving evidence of an ancient bat-associated deltaretrovirus lineage.
erv_lineage.notes: Expands the known diversity of endogenous deltaretroviruses.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: Delta.6-PlaMin
erv_lineage.description: Deltaretrovirus-derived ERV identified in the river dolphin (Platanista) genome.
erv_lineage.notes: Provides evidence for a broader historical distribution of deltaretroviruses.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: Delta.9-MolMol
erv_lineage.description: Ancient deltaretrovirus lineage identified in Mollosus bats.
erv_lineage.notes: Demonstrates deltaretroviruses have entered bat germlines on multiple independent occasions.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: DELV
erv_lineage.description: Ancient endogenous lentivirus lineage identified in colugos (Dermoptera).
erv_lineage.notes: Provides some of the strongest evidence that lentiviruses have been infecting mammals since at least the early Cenozoic

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: EqERV-Rb
erv_lineage.description: Horse endogenous retrovirus lineage belonging to the 'rho' subgroup of clade I retroviruses.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: EqERV-S
erv_lineage.description: Equid member of the ERV-S (Sigma)-related retrovirus group.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: EqERV-Zeta
erv_lineage.description: Equid member of the 'Zeta' group of endogenous clade I retroviruses.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: GLN
erv_lineage.description: Gammaretrovirus lineage related to koala retrovirus (KoRV) and gibbon ape leukemia virus (GALV).
erv_lineage.notes: Part of the retrovirus group that includes KoRV and GALV.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-15
erv_lineage.description: Ancient gammaretrovirus lineage discovered through expression-based cloning in human teratocarcinoma cells.
erv_lineage.notes: First recognised as the retinoic acid-inducible human endogenous retrovirus I (RRHERV-I).

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-24
erv_lineage.description: Obscure clade I retrovirus lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-30
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-4
erv_lineage.description: Obscure Clade I retrovirus lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-46
erv_lineage.description: Obscure clade I retrovirus lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-9
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Generated a large population of LTR sequences that contribute regulatory elements to the human genome.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-ADP
erv_lineage.notes: Related endogenous retroviruses occur across diverse vertebrate groups, including non-mammalian lineages.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-E
erv_lineage.description: Ancient gammaretrovirus lineage likely present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch or earlier

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-Fa
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-Fb
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage likely originating in the Oligocene epoch or earlier.
erv_lineage.notes: Includes the locus that encodes suppressyn (SUPYN).

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-Fc1
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Miocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Distributed across multiple mammalian orders and useful for reconstructing recent waves of ERV colonisation during mammalian evolution.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-Fc2
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Miocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Distributed across multiple mammalian orders and useful for reconstructing recent waves of ERV colonisation during mammalian evolution.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-FRD
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Source of multiple human genes derived from viral proteins, including syncytin-2.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-H
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Thousands of HERV-H-derived sequences contribute promoters, enhancers and transcripts active in human embryonic stem cells.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-I
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in the Eocene but potentially much older.
erv_lineage.notes: Related endogenous retroviruses occur across diverse vertebrate groups, including non-mammalian lineages.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-K-HML5
erv_lineage.description: Ancient betaretrovirus lineage likely present in mammalian ancestors by the Eocene epoch or earlier.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-K-HML6
erv_lineage.description: Ancient betaretrovirus lineage likely present in mammalian ancestors by the Eocene epoch or earlier.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-L
erv_lineage.description: Clade III retrovirus lineage originating in the late Cretaceous epoch, lacks an envelope gene, very high copy number.
erv_lineage.notes: Among the oldest ERV lineages known in mammals.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-Lb
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-P
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-R
erv_lineage.description: Ancient gammaretrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Oligocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Includes ERV3-1, one of the earliest recognised envelope-derived human genes.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-Rb
erv_lineage.description: Distinct clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Encodes ERVPABLB-1 (envR(b)), a conserved envelope-derived human gene expressed in placenta.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-S
erv_lineage.description: Ancient clade III retrovirus lineage, likely present in mammals by the late Cretaceous.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-T
erv_lineage.description: Ancient gammaretrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch
erv_lineage.notes: Source of at least one co-opted env gene co-opted in human ancestors.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-U3
erv_lineage.description: Ancient clade III retrovirus lineage present in mammalian ancestors by the Late Cretaceous.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-W
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.
erv_lineage.notes: Encodes Syncytin-1, a co-opted viral envelope protein essential for placental development.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: HERV-XA
erv_lineage.description: Clade I retrovirus lineage present in primate ancestors by the Eocene epoch.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: IAPE
erv_lineage.description: Highly active murine betaretrovirus-derived retrotransposons that replicate within endoplasmic-reticulum-associated intracellular particles.
erv_lineage.notes: Historically one of the most important endogenous retrovirus systems, helping reveal how infectious retroviruses can evolve into highly successful intracellular genomic parasites.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: KwERV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage found in killer whales and other toothed whales (Odontoceti).
erv_lineage.notes: First full-length endogenous retrovirus characterised in a cetacean species and retains a largely intact, transcriptionally active genome.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: MELVmpf
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous lentivirus lineage identified in mustelids, including ferrets, mink and otters.
erv_lineage.notes: Provided the first evidence that lentiviruses had infected members of the dog-like carnivore lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: MER-34
erv_lineage.description: Obscure clade I retrovirus lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: MER-66
erv_lineage.description: Obscure Clade I retrovirus lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: MinERVa
erv_lineage.description: Ancient deltaretrovirus lineage identified in long-fingered bats (Miniopteridae).
erv_lineage.notes: The first endogenous deltaretrovirus discovered.

erv_lineage.rv_species.full_name: Mus musculus endogenous retroviral sequence MuERV-L
erv_lineage.rv_species.name: MuERV-L
erv_lineage.description: Ancient endogenous retrovirus lineage lacking an envelope gene and highly amplified in mammals.
erv_lineage.notes: Highly expressed during the earliest stages of murine embryonic development.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: mysTR
erv_lineage.description: Highly amplified betaretrovirus-like lineage found in South American rodents.
erv_lineage.notes: Expanded to unprecedented copy numbers (~10,000 copies) making it one of the most successful endogenous retrovirus lineages known.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: PERV-C
erv_lineage.description: Porcine endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage restricted to pigs and closely related suids.
erv_lineage.notes: Although PERV-C infects only pig cells, recombination with PERV-A can generate PERV-A/C viruses capable of infecting human cells in vitro, making it a major focus of xenotransplantation safety research.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: PRIMA-41
erv_lineage.description: Obscure Clade I retrovirus lineage.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: PSIV2
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous lentivirus lineage identified in Malagasy dwarf lemurs.
erv_lineage.notes: Represents a second, independent primate lentivirus germline infiltration that occurred almost simultaneously with pSIV1 about 4 million years ago.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: pSIVgml
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous lentivirus identified in mouse lemurs

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: PyERV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous betaretrovirus lineage identified in pythons.
erv_lineage.notes: Extends the known host range of betaretroviruses beyond mammals.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: RD114
erv_lineage.description: Feline endogenous gammaretrovirus lineage that gave rise to the prototype RD114 virus.
erv_lineage.notes: Uses the amino acid transporter SLC1A5 (ASCT2) as its receptor and helped establish fundamental principles of retroviral receptor biology.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: RELIK
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous rabbit lentivirus lineage.
erv_lineage.notes: The first endogenous lentivirus discovered, providing the first direct evidence that lentiviruses have circulated in mammals for at least 12 million years.

erv_lineage.rv_species.full_name: Oryctolagus cuniculus clone A rabbit endogenous retrovirus H
erv_lineage.rv_species.name: RERV-H
erv_lineage.description: Betaretrovirus-like endogenous retroviral sequence originally identified during searches for novel human retroviruses.
erv_lineage.notes: Originally reported as "Human Retrovirus 5" (HRV-5), a putative human retrovirus associated with autoimmune disease, before being shown to derive from rabbit-associated sequences.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: SloEFV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous foamy virus lineage identified in sloths.
erv_lineage.notes: First endogenous spumavirus to be discovered.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: SpELV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous lentivirus lineage identified in spring hares
erv_lineage.notes: Shows that lentiviruses infected ancestral rodents.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: Spuma-Ame.b
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous foamy virus lineage identified in amphibians.
erv_lineage.notes: Provides evidence that foamy viruses have infected tetrapods outside amniotes.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: Spuma-Rbi
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous foamy virus lineage identified in amphibians.
erv_lineage.notes: Extends the known host range of foamy viruses to amphibians.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: TgERV-F
erv_lineage.description: Recombinant avian retrovirus lineage combining alpharetrovirus-like and gammaretrovirus-like features.
erv_lineage.notes: Represents a rare example of a retrovirus that acquired an envelope gene from a distantly related mammalian retrovirus.

erv_lineage.rv_species.name: TuataraEFV
erv_lineage.description: Endogenous foamy virus lineage identified in tuatara.
erv_lineage.notes: Demonstrates that foamy viruses infected reptilian ancestors in deep evolutionary time.
